name: Bjorn Lindstrom
bio:
Bjorn Lindstrom's career has been a blend of human resources and motorsport passion. After graduating with a degree in Business Administration, Bjorn spent several years in general HR roles, quickly realizing his talent for talent acquisition and employee relations. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he saw an opportunity to combine his professional skills with his personal interests and transitioned into motorsport, seeking a role where he could contribute to building high-performing teams.

In his role as HR Manager, Bjorn prioritizes fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. He's known for his ability to identify and attract top talent, developing comprehensive training programs, and mediating conflicts effectively. He believes in empowering employees to reach their full potential, leading to a more engaged and productive workforce. His experience with both large corporations and smaller race teams gives him a unique perspective on managing diverse workforces.

What sets Bjorn apart is his strategic mindset and dedication to continuous improvement. He's always looking for innovative ways to enhance HR practices, from implementing advanced recruitment techniques to promoting employee wellness programs. His goal is to create a workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and motivated to achieve success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Bjorn is a man of medium build with a thoughtful expression, often seen with a slight smile.

quirks: Always has a small Rubik's cube on his desk and solves it during phone calls.
Prefers using a fountain pen for all written communication.
Insists on having fika (Swedish coffee break) at 3 PM sharp, no exceptions.
